The main shrine of Watatsumi is [[Shikaumi Shrines]] the ancestral shrine of the [[Azumi people]]

'''Kaijin Shrine''' (海神社, also read as Amajinja, Kaijinja, or Watatsumijinja) refers to various [[Shrine|Shinto shrines]]:

* [[Watatsumi Shrine_(Kobe)|Watatsumi Shrines]] - Located in {{ill|Tarumi-ku, Kobe|en|Tarumi-ku, Kobe|qid=Q1078806|lt=Tarumi-ku, Kobe|1=Tarumi-ku, Kobe}}, {{ill|Kobe|en|Kobe|qid=Q48320|lt=Kobe|1=Kobe}}, {{ill|Hyōgo Prefecture|en|Hyōgo Prefecture|qid=Q130290|lt=Hyōgo Prefecture|1=Hyōgo Prefecture}}. It is a {{ill|Myōjin Taisha|ja|名神大社|lt=Shikinaisha Myōjin Taisha|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Myōjin Taisha|comment=enwiki is a redirect}} and a former {{ill|Kanpeichūsha|ja|官幣中社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanpeichūsha|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 近代社格制度|1=Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q712534}}.
* {{ill|Kaijin Shrine (Toyooka)|ja|海神社 (豊岡市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kaijin Shrine (Toyooka)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Located in {{ill|Toyooka, Hyōgo|en|Toyooka, Hyōgo|qid=Q696388|lt=Toyooka City|1=Toyooka, Hyōgo}}, Hyōgo Prefecture. It is a Shikinaisha Myōjin Taisha and a former {{ill|Village Shrine|ja|村社|1=Son-sha|qid=Q134917284}}{{efn|Former shrine rank|lt=Son-sha|1=modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|lt=Sonsha|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Village Shrine|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 近代社格制度|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q712534}}.
* {{ill|Kaijin Shrine (Kinokawa)|ja|海神社 (紀の川市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kaijin Shrine (Kinokawa)|qq=}} - Located in {{ill|Kinokawa, Wakayama|en|Kinokawa, Wakayama|qid=Q697002|lt=Kinokawa, Wakayama|1=Kinokawa, Wakayama}}, {{ill|Wakayama Prefecture|en|Wakayama Prefecture|qid=Q131314|lt=Wakayama Prefecture|1=Wakayama Prefecture}}. It is a former {{ill|Prefectural Shrine|ja|県社|1=Ken-sha|qid=Q90139226}}{{efn|Ken-sha|WD=Q90139226|lt=Ken-sha|1=modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|lt=Kensha|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Prefectural Shrine|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 近代社格制度|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q712534}}.
* {{ill|Kaijin Shrine (Nishinoshima)|ja|海神社 (西ノ島町)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kaijin Shrine (Nishinoshima)|1=Kai Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11559097}} - Located in {{ill|Nishinoshima, Shimane|en|Nishinoshima, Shimane|qid=Q543193|lt=Nishinoshima, Shimane|1=Nishinoshima, Shimane}}, [[:en:Oki District|Oki District]], {{ill|Shimane Prefecture|en|Shimane Prefecture|qid=Q132751|lt=Shimane Prefecture|1=Shimane Prefecture}}. It is a Shikinaisha Shōsha (minor shrine) and a former Village Shrine.
* {{ill|Kaijin Shrine (Iki)|ja|海神社 (壱岐市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kaijin Shrine (Iki)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Located in {{ill|Iki, Nagasaki|en|Iki, Nagasaki|qid=Q861519|lt=Iki City|1=Iki, Nagasaki}}, {{ill|Nagasaki Prefecture|en|Nagasaki Prefecture|qid=Q169376|lt=Nagasaki Prefecture|1=Nagasaki Prefecture}}. It is a Shikinaisha Taisha and a former Village Shrine.

Watatsumi Shrine can refer to the following

* [[Watatsumi Shrine_(Kobe)|Watatsumi Shrines]]
* [[Watazumi Shrines]] sometimes read as Watatsumi Shrine
* [[Kaijin Shrines]] sometimes read as Watatsumi Shrine
* Another shrine to {{ill|Watatsumi|en|Watatsumi|qid=Q1474187|lt=Watatsumi|1=Watatsumi}}
